entry.title: New: BILL071(25) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO SHARED STREETS.

Establishes a Shared Streets Program to provide a safe, accessible, and efficient space for all users of designated shared street areas, with priority given to pedestrians and other non-motorized users. To establish a designated shared street area, requires the affirmative recommendation from the DTS Director, the opportunity for public participation, and Council approval by resolution.

Latest action: Second reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
